title: [Financial Reports] Faster row/column definition entry and custom schedule email subject
summary: Financial reports now support faster row and column definition entry through field type defaulting, custom schedule email subjects, and improved searchability for report schedules.
key_points: Row and column definition lines default type fields from previous line to accelerate data entry
Financial report schedules can specify custom email subject; blank value triggers existing default
Financial Report Schedules page now searchable with UsageCategory = Lists
Added tests for type inheritance and custom subject behavior
